visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair and a white sleeveless lace-trimmed top stands in a public outdoor area. She has light makeup with pink eyeshadow and a small glitter heart under her eye. Behind her, large banners with anime-style characters are visible. She holds a RODE microphone close to her mouth, speaking directly toward the camera with a slight smile. (2) A young man with dark, straight hair, wearing a black T-shirt and a white surgical mask, is being interviewed. He holds a similar RODE microphone and wears a silver chain necklace. The background shows a modern building entrance with people walking by and large blue promotional posters for a gaming event. (3) The scene shifts to a wider shot in an open plaza under natural daylight. The host, wearing black sunglasses and a lanyard with a gaming card, stands between the two participants. The woman and man stand back-to-back initially, then rotate 180 degrees on the stone-tiled floor to face each other. They interact with hand gestures and finally shake hands in a formal greeting while the host looks on.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear female voice with high-pitched energy introduces herself over an upbeat EDM background track. The BGM features a steady synth beat. A sharp 'ding' sound effect rings out when a game rank is mentioned. Ambient wind and distant crowd chatter are heard faintly in the background. (2) A male voice, slightly muffled by a mask but clear in tone, responds to the host. The BGM maintains a consistent mid-tempo pulse. A prominent 'whoosh' transition sound effect punctuates the shift between dialogue clips. The host's voice is deep and projected. (3) Multiple voices interact in an outdoor setting. The BGM swells with a brighter melody as the reveal occurs. Soft percussive thuds of footsteps on stone are audible as the participants move. A 'magical sparkle' sound effect plays during the final introduction, accompanied by light laughter and the continuation of the driving electronic rhythm.
